Verdict: approve.

Top call is justified as a plurality, not a certainty: two atlas queries give 5/10 Protein synthesis neighbours (sim 0.887-0.929, mean 0.906) ahead of Microtubule destabilizers (4/10, mean 0.862), with 0 Aurora neighbours despite visual multinucleation. ## Unblinding

Compound: **emetine** (PubChem CID [10219](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/10219))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: no curated mechanism in ChEMBL

## Verdict (computed by code)

Correct: agent said **Protein synthesis**, BBBC021 annotates **Protein synthesis**.

## Reflection

The correct Protein synthesis call came from trusting replicated atlas evidence over visual impression: four wells from 0.1-30 uM showed concordant extreme nuclear shape loss and texture changes with 5/10 Protein synthesis neighbours at sim ~0.91 in two queries. Recognizing the flat cell-count and multinucleation dose-responses as saturation rather than lack of effect was key, supported by literature that emetine inhibits ribosome translocation (PMID 42539200).

The microscopist report favoring Aurora kinase inhibitors and the strong tubulin/actin texture contrast misled me to retain Aurora at 0.10 and Microtubule destabilizers at 0.18. The atlas margin was narrow with 3-4/10 microtubule destabilizer neighbours, so I correctly kept confidence modest at 0.58.

Sampling 0.1 uM as the lowest dose was already saturated, so I missed the true potency onset and could not define an EC50. No re-analysis of the already-concordant profiles would have overturned the plurality without new biological data.

What was right:
- Trusted stable 5/10 Protein synthesis atlas plurality across two queries (e5, e9) over visual Aurora suggestion (e4).
- Recognized extreme nuclear form-factor/solidity z -30 to -57 across e2, e3, e7, e8 as potent concordant phenotype, not single-well artifact.
- Interpreted flat Spearman dose-responses for cell count and multinucleation (e10, e11) as saturation from 0.1 uM onward rather than inactivity.

What was wrong or missed:
- Over-weighted visual multinucleation and Aurora hypothesis from describe_phenotype (e4) despite zero Aurora atlas neighbours.
- Retained Microtubule destabilizers too highly due to tub_glcm_contrast z +25.3 and actin contrast, ignoring higher Protein synthesis similarity mean 0.906 vs 0.862.
- Missed potency onset by not acquiring below 0.1 uM, leaving dose-response uninformative for EC50.

Proposed next experiment: OPP puromycylation translation assay with phospho-H3 and DNA-content flow in fresh cells to confirm acute protein synthesis block versus Aurora/mitotic arrest.
